name: One&Only Reethi Rah
positioning: Villa resort on one of the largest islands in North Male Atoll, with thatch-roofed villas spread along 12 beaches
best_for: Couples who want a villa with a bathtub for two on a large private island
Travelers who want beaches and snorkeling over a resort coral garden

facts.text: The resort is on one of the largest islands in North Male Atoll.
The resort is a 45-minute boat ride from the Maldives capital, Male.
Transfers from Velana International Airport can be arranged by sea or air.
Reethi Rah means 'beautiful island' in Dhivehi, the local language.
The resort holds an EarthCheck Platinum certificate.
The resort's coral garden nurtures the local marine life.
Reethi Rah time is set one hour ahead of Male time, giving an extra hour of daylight at the end of the day.
Complimentary WiFi is available across the resort.
The villas are thatch-roofed and all have terrazzo bathtubs for two.
Fanditha is the resort's Moroccan restaurant, with daybeds outside for meals.

highlights.text: The villas are spread along the 12 beaches of the 109-acre island.
